svg.text: NVLINK/NVSWITCH (SCALE-UP) VS. INFINIBAND & ROCEV2 RDMA (SCALE-OUT) DEEP DIVE
Hierarchical NVLink/NVLS + GPUDirect RDMA (Rail-Optimized + PXN) Hits 95.2% Line-Rate busbw
512-GPU 400G Cluster: Tier 1 Untuned RoCEv2 (11.8 GB/s busbw, $1.15M/mo) vs. Tier 2 Tuned RoCEv2 (45.4 GB/s) vs. Tier 4 ($365K/mo)
⛔ Tier 1 Traps: Host RAM Bounce & PFC Pause Storms
1. Missing `nvidia-peermem` GPUDirect RDMA (46 GB/s -> 11.8 GB/s):
• Without GPUDirect RDMA + PCIe Switch ACS off, packets bounce
through Host CPU DRAM via QPI/UPI, collapsing throughput by 4x!
2. Static 5-Tuple ECMP + Pure PFC on RoCEv2 (14 Deadlocks/Mo):
• Low-entropy RDMA QP elephant flows collide on the same Spine
uplink; reactive PFC pause frames cascade into buffer deadlocks
3. Confusing `algbw` with `busbw` in `nccl-tests` Acceptance:
• Ring AllReduce `busbw = algbw * 2(N-1)/N` measures true wire speed
Untuned RoCEv2 Failure Impact (512-GPU 400G Cluster):
• Measured NCCL AllReduce `busbw`: Only 11.8 GB/s (of 50 GB/s!)
• P99 Collective Latency: 94.0ms | PFC Deadlocks: 14 / month
• Monthly Network & Stranded GPU TCO: $1,150,000 / month
🏆 Tier 4: NVLink/NVLS + Rail-Optimized GPUDirect RDMA
1. Scale-Up NVLink 4/5 (900–1,800 GB/s) vs. Scale-Out RDMA (50–100 GB/s):
• NVLink provides sub-us memory-semantic load/store + `NVLS` for TP;
8x 400G/800G NICs carry FSDP/DP/EP over `GPUDirect RDMA` zero-copy
2. Rail-Optimized Topology + `NCCL PXN` (1-Hop Intra-Rail):
• Connects all `GPU #i` to `Rail Leaf #i`; `PXN` routes cross-rail
packets via intra-node NVLink first so Spine hops drop by 78%!
3. Lossless RoCEv2 (`ECN Before PFC + DCQCN + DLB/Spray + Watchdog`):
• Early ECN marks throttle senders before PFC triggers (`45.4 GB/s`)
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks (400G Per GPU):
• Measured NCCL `busbw`: 47.6 GB/s (95.2% of 50 GB/s line rate!)
• P99 Collective Latency: 4.9ms | PFC Deadlocks: 0 / month
• Monthly Total TCO: $365,000 / mo (-68.3% savings vs. Tier 1)
